```{r setup, include=FALSE}
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(stringr)
library(lubridate)
library(purrr)
library(hms)
library(writexl)
library(here) 
library(fs)
library(kableExtra)

# 1. Define paths using here() - This solves the "Path does not exist" error
data_path <- here(params$data_dir, params$data_file)
out_dir   <- here(params$out_dir)

# 2. Create output folder if it doesn't exist
if (!dir.exists(out_dir)) dir.create(out_dir, recursive = TRUE)

# 3. Helpers
options(scipen = 999)
fmt2 <- function(x) ifelse(is.na(x), NA_character_, sprintf("%.2f", round(as.numeric(x), 2)))
# Small helper: parse mixed start-hour inputs -> numeric hour mapping
parse_start_hour_short <- function(x) {
  x_chr <- as.character(x)
  sapply(x_chr, function(v) {
    if (is.na(v) || v == "") return(NA_real_)
    v <- trimws(v)
    # HH:MM or HH:MM:SS
    if (grepl("^\\d{1,2}:\\d{2}(:\\d{2})?$", v)) {
      parts <- strsplit(v, ":")[[1]]
      h <- as.numeric(parts[1]); m <- as.numeric(parts[2])
      if (is.na(h)) return(NA_real_)
      if (h == 0) return(24)
      if (h >= 1 && h <= 3) return(h + 24)
      return(as.numeric(h) + as.numeric(m)/60)
    }
    num <- suppressWarnings(as.numeric(v))
    if (!is.na(num)) {
      if (num > 1000) return(NA_real_)       # Excel serial/date -> NA for start-hour
      if (num > 0 && num < 2) return(num * 24) # fractional day -> hours
      if (num >= 0 && num < 50) return(num) # already hour-scale
    }
    return(NA_real_)
  }, USE.NAMES = FALSE)
}

```


# Read NPCRA Files

```{r format-data-only, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
library(readxl)
library(hms)
library(lubridate)
library(dplyr)
library(stringr)
library(readr)
library(writexl)

# Use the stable path from the setup chunk
if (!file.exists(data_path)) {
  stop("CRITICAL ERROR: File not found at ", data_path)
}

df <- read_excel(data_path)

# Standardise required columns
nm <- names(df)
need <- c("id","variable","timepoint","value")
idx <- match(need, tolower(nm))
if (any(is.na(idx))) stop("Expected columns: id, Variable, timepoint, Value (any case).")
names(df)[idx] <- c("id","Variable","timepoint","Value")

df <- df %>%
  mutate(
    id = as.character(id),
    timepoint = as.character(timepoint),
    Variable = as.character(Variable), 
    Value = as.numeric(Value)
  )

## keep a copy BEFORE you coerce Value to numeric
df_raw <- read_excel(data_path)
names(df_raw)[match(c("id","variable","timepoint","value"), tolower(names(df_raw)))] <-
  c("id","Variable","timepoint","Value")

# 1) Start-hour rows: parse "HH:MM" to a time object, then map 00->24, 01–03->25–27
start_hours <- c("L5 Start Hour", "M10 Start Hour")

# 2) Numeric rows: now coerce
NPCRA_numeric <- df %>%                    # <- this is your df with Value as.numeric() already
  dplyr::filter(!Variable %in% start_hours)

start_NPCRA_data <- df_raw %>%
  dplyr::filter(Variable %in% start_hours) %>%
  mutate(t = readr::parse_time(as.character(Value), format = "%H:%M"),
         h = as.numeric(t) / 3600,
         Value = dplyr::case_when(
           abs(h) < 1e-9 ~ 24,
           h >= 1 & h <= 3 ~ h + 24,
           TRUE ~ h
         )) %>%
  select(id, Variable, timepoint, Value)
# 3) Bind (all numeric now)
NPCRA_data <- dplyr::bind_rows(NPCRA_numeric, start_NPCRA_data)



# Function to convert time format
convert_time <- function(time_hms) {
  if (is.na(time_hms)) return(NA)  # Handle NA values
  
  hour <- hour(time_hms)  # Extract hour using lubridate
  
  if (hour == 0) {
    return(24)  # Convert midnight (00:00) to 24
  } else if (hour >= 1 & hour <= 3) {
    return(hour + 24)  # Convert 01:00 → 25, 02:00 → 26, 03:00 → 27
  } else {
    return(hour)  # Keep all other hours unchanged 
  }
}

# Apply function to start hour data
start_NPCRA_data <- start_NPCRA_data %>%
  mutate(Value = map_dbl(Value, convert_time), 
         Value = as.numeric(Value)) 

NPCRA_data <- bind_rows(start_NPCRA_data, df) %>% 
  mutate(Value = as.numeric(Value))

```

# Summary stats

```{r}

summary_stats_NPCRA <- NPCRA_data %>%
  group_by(Variable, timepoint) %>%
  summarise(
    n = sum(!is.na(Value)),
    mean_value = mean(Value, na.rm = TRUE),
    sd_value   = sd(Value, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    mean_value = fmt2(mean_value),
    sd_value   = fmt2(sd_value)
  ) %>%
  arrange(Variable, timepoint)

# Print nice table
kable(head(summary_stats_NPCRA, 40), caption = "Mean ± SD by NPCRA Variable and Timepoint")
 
```


#Linear mixed model
```{r}
# ---------- Diagnostics & setup ----------
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(lme4)
library(emmeans)
library(purrr)
library(writexl)
library(knitr)

options(scipen = 999)  # avoid scientific notation
fmt2 <- function(x) ifelse(is.na(x), NA_character_, sprintf("%.2f", round(as.numeric(x), 2)))

# Quick diagnostics: counts per timepoint and distinct ids
cat("Counts per timepoint:\n")
print(NPCRA_data %>% count(timepoint) %>% arrange(timepoint))
cat("\nDistinct ids total:", n_distinct(NPCRA_data$id), "\n")

cat("\nIDs with BSL and at least one post-BSL:\n")
print(
  NPCRA_data %>%
    group_by(id) %>%
    summarise(
      has_BSL = any(timepoint == "BSL"),
      has_post = any(timepoint != "BSL"),
      .groups = "drop"
    ) %>%
    filter(has_BSL) %>%
    summarise(ids_with_BSL = n(), ids_with_BSL_and_post = sum(has_post))
)

# ---------- function: mirror of run_sleep_lmm but for NPCRA long format ----------
run_NPCRA_lmm <- function(df_long, varname) {
  # df_long: NPCRA_data long format (id, timepoint, Variable, Value)
  # varname: character, exact Variable name to analyze (e.g., "L5 Average")
  message("Variable: ", varname)
  df1 <- df_long %>%
    filter(Variable == varname) %>%
    select(id, timepoint, Value) %>%
    group_by(id, timepoint) %>%
    summarise(Value = mean(as.numeric(Value), na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") %>%
    filter(!is.na(Value))
  
  # diagnostics
  cat("  Observed timepoint levels:", paste(sort(unique(df1$timepoint)), collapse = ", "), "\n")
  cat("  Distinct ids:", n_distinct(df1$id), "  Rows:", nrow(df1), "\n")
  
  # requirements
  if (!("BSL" %in% df1$timepoint)) {
    cat("  -> SKIP: no BSL present for this variable\n"); return(NULL)
  }
  if (n_distinct(df1$id) < 2) {
    cat("  -> SKIP: fewer than 2 distinct ids\n"); return(NULL)
  }
  if (nrow(df1 %>% filter(timepoint != "BSL")) == 0) {
    cat("  -> SKIP: no post-BSL observations\n"); return(NULL)
  }
  
  # set factor levels: BSL as reference first then others in natural sorted order
  other_levels <- setdiff(sort(unique(df1$timepoint)), "BSL")
  df1 <- df1 %>% mutate(timepoint = factor(timepoint, levels = c("BSL", other_levels)))
  
  # fit LMM (safe tryCatch)
  fit <- tryCatch(
    lmer(Value ~ timepoint + (1 | id), data = df1, REML = TRUE),
    error = function(e) { cat("  -> lmer ERROR:", e$message, "\n"); NULL }
  )
  if (is.null(fit)) return(NULL)
  
  # emmeans + contrasts vs BSL
  em <- tryCatch(emmeans(fit, ~ timepoint), error = function(e) { cat("  -> emmeans ERROR:", e$message, "\n"); NULL })
  if (is.null(em)) return(NULL)
  
  ct <- tryCatch({
    contrast(em, method = "trt.vs.ctrl", ref = "BSL") %>%
      summary(infer = TRUE, adjust = "none") %>% as.data.frame()
  }, error = function(e) { cat("  -> contrast ERROR:", e$message, "\n"); NULL })
  if (is.null(ct)) return(NULL)
  
  # pivot to wide aggregated per id so we can compute observed change pairs
  wide <- df1 %>% pivot_wider(names_from = timepoint, values_from = Value)
  
  # get the 'against' week names (right-hand-side of each contrast string)
  # contrast names typically like "Week 1 - BSL"
  against <- gsub(" - BSL", "", ct$contrast, fixed = TRUE)
  
  sd_change <- sapply(against, function(w) {
    if (all(c("BSL", w) %in% colnames(wide))) {
      sd_val <- sd(wide[[w]] - wide$BSL, na.rm = TRUE)
      if (is.nan(sd_val)) NA_real_ else sd_val
    } else NA_real_
  })
  d_vals <- sapply(against, function(w) {
    if (all(c("BSL", w) %in% colnames(wide))) {
      mean_change <- mean(wide[[w]] - wide$BSL, na.rm = TRUE)
      sd_ch <- sd(wide[[w]] - wide$BSL, na.rm = TRUE)
      if (is.na(sd_ch) || sd_ch == 0) NA_real_ else mean_change / sd_ch
    } else NA_real_
  })
  
  # assemble results; ensure numeric CM column names exist (estimate, SE, lower.CL, upper.CL)
  out <- ct %>%
    mutate(
      variable = varname,
      estimate_num = as.numeric(estimate),
      lower.CL = as.numeric(lower.CL),
      upper.CL = as.numeric(upper.CL),
      SD_change = sd_change,
      Cohens_d = d_vals
    ) %>%
    transmute(
      variable,
      contrast,
      estimate = estimate_num,
      lower.CL,
      upper.CL,
      SD_change,
      Cohens_d
    )
  
  return(out)
}

# ---------- run for specified variables ----------
# choose variables you want to analyze (example: numeric NPCRA variables)
variables_to_run <- c("L5 Average", "M10 Average", "RA (Relative Amplitude)", "IS (Interdaily Stability)", "IV (Intra-daily Variability)", "L5 Start Hour", "M10 Start Hour")

eff_list <- lapply(variables_to_run, function(v) run_NPCRA_lmm(NPCRA_data, v))
eff_list <- purrr::compact(eff_list)  # drop NULL
NPCRA_effects <- bind_rows(eff_list)

# ---------- save raw numeric results ----------
writexl::write_xlsx(NPCRA_effects, file.path(out_dir, "NPCRA_LMM_raw_results.xlsx"))
cat("✅ Saved raw numeric results to ", file.path(out_dir, "NPCRA_LMM_raw_results.xlsx"), "\n")

# ---------- format for manuscript: 2 decimals, 95% CI, Cohen's d ----------
if (nrow(NPCRA_effects) == 0) {
  cat("No LMM results produced for the requested variables.\n")
} else {
  NPCRA_results_fmt <- NPCRA_effects %>%
    mutate(
      estimate = as.numeric(estimate),
      lower.CL = as.numeric(lower.CL),
      upper.CL = as.numeric(upper.CL),
      Cohens_d = as.numeric(Cohens_d),
      `Estimate` = sprintf("%.2f", estimate),
      `95% CI`   = paste0(sprintf("%.2f", lower.CL), " to ", sprintf("%.2f", upper.CL)),
      `Cohen's d` = ifelse(is.na(Cohens_d), NA_character_, sprintf("%.2f", Cohens_d))
    ) %>%
    select(variable, contrast, `Estimate`, `95% CI`, `Cohen's d`) %>%
    arrange(variable, contrast)
  
  # Save formatted table
  writexl::write_xlsx(NPCRA_results_fmt, file.path(out_dir, "NPCRA_LMM_results.xlsx"))
  cat("✅ Saved formatted manuscript table to ", file.path(out_dir, "NPCRA_LMM_results_xlsx"), "\n")
  
  # show table in report
  knitr::kable(NPCRA_results_fmt, caption = "NPCRA LMM — contrasts vs Baseline (estimate, 95% CI, Cohen's d)")
}


```
